Give each simulated unit the growth-curve traits of a member species

Source: R/landweb-growth-curves.R
landweb_unit_growth_traits.Rd

Each unit of a study area takes, from the shared fit, the traits of its member with most cover among those whose curve was fitted (growthCurveSource "estimated"); a unit none of whose members was fitted takes its dominant member's traits, which are then hardwood or softwood means. Members follow the unit's ranked order (species in neverSplit last); without it, the dominant member is used. A merged fir unit dominated by unfitted balsam fir thus takes subalpine fir's fitted curve rather than the conifer mean. The traits' source is recorded in growthTraitSource, e.g. "estimated (Abie_las)". Apply the result to speciesEcoregion with LandR::modifySpeciesAndSpeciesEcoregionTable().

landweb_unit_growth_traits(species, traits, units)

Arguments

species

a study area's species table (one row per unit), from data preparation.

traits

from landweb_growth_traits().

units

the study area's units, from landweb_species_units().

Value

A copy of species with the traits set.
